theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Energy (+1.80%) and Communication Svcs (+0.81%) led the market today, while Health Care (-1.35%) and Financials (-0.42%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.34%, defensives -0.32%, and value/cyclicals +0.27% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 -0.02%, Dow -0.35%, Nasdaq -0.15% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps underperformed as well, with the Russell 2000 at -0.40%, hinting the move favored large, established balance sheets over smaller, more rate-sensitive companies. The VIX rose 0.39% to 15.27, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.74% to $4,180.10, crude oil was little changed at $94.86, and bitcoin gained 0.07% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
